card.name: Right before the word frequent
card.fires_on: The word piece FRE in capitalized FREQUENCY or FREQUENT, and the word 'less' right before 'frequent' or 'frequently'. It fires where the next word is expected to be a form of 'frequency'.

modes.label: Split FREQUENCY
modes.description: The first piece FRE of an all-caps or split 'frequency/frequent' word.
modes.example: THE RECOMMENDED DOSAGE,<< FRE>>QUENCY, OR INFUSION RATE MUST

modes.label: 'less' before frequent
modes.description: The word 'less' right before 'frequent' or 'frequently' when describing monitoring or dosing intervals.
modes.example: Thereafter, if the patient is clinically stable,<< less>> frequent routine monitoring is recommended.

card.writes: It boosts word starts beginning with 'fre' and suppresses full forms of 'frequency' in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It marks the spot where the next word is 'frequent' or 'frequency', as in 'less frequent monitoring' or 'dosage, frequency'.
